name: Build and deploy presskit on: push: branches: [main] workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write concurrency: group: gh-pages cancel-in-progress: true jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup Node uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 20 - name: Install presskit run: npm install -g presskit - name: Build site # Folder containing data.xml (use "." if it's at the repo root). # Add --pretty-links if you want URLs without index.html. run: presskit build . - name: Deploy to gh-pages branch uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4 with: github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} publish_dir: ./build publish_branch: gh-pages
